titulo.alumno:
«Бюджет семьи и обязательные расходы»
Household budget and fixed costs

intro: To read a budget, distinguish income, fixed costs, variable costs and savings; percentages and amounts must refer to the same period.

piezas.titulo: To read a budget, distinguish income, fixed costs, variable costs and savings; percentages and amounts must refer to the same period.
texto: To read a budget, distinguish income, fixed costs, variable costs and savings; percentages and amounts must refer to the same period.
The expressions составлять бюджет and расходы на жильё help identify the function of each item.

frases.estudio: Почти треть месячного дохода семьи уходит на аренду и коммунальные услуги.
frases.alumno: Almost a third of the household's monthly income goes on rent and utilities.

frases.estudio: После обязательных платежей семья откладывает небольшую сумму на ремонт.
frases.alumno: After compulsory payments, the family sets aside a small sum for repairs.

pregunta.texto: Which expense takes up almost a third of the income?

opciones.explicacion: The first sentence identifies the costs that reach almost a third.
